27.english_reference: seven years reigned he in Hebron

traditions.KJV: seven years reigned he in Hebron ,

27.english_reference: and thirty and three [ years ] reigned he in Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וּ בִ ירוּשָׁלִַ֥ם מָלַ֖ךְ שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְ שָׁלֽוֹשׁ

traditions.VUL: et in Ierúsalem annis trigínta tribus .
traditions.KJV: and thirty and three [ years ] reigned he in Jerusalem .

28.english_reference: And he died in a good old age , full of days , riches , and honour

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֨מָת֙ בְּ שֵׂיבָ֣ה טוֹבָ֔ה שְׂבַ֥ע יָמִ֖ים עֹ֣שֶׁר וְ כָב֑וֹד

28.english_reference: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנ֖ וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי ו

traditions.VUL: et regnávit Sálomon fílius eius pro eo .
traditions.KJV: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead .

29.english_reference: Now the acts of David the king , first and last , behold , they [ are ] written

traditions.WLC: וְ דִבְרֵי֙ דָּוִ֣יד הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ הָ רִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְ הָ אֲחרֹנִ֑ים הִנָּ֣ ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים
traditions.LXX: οἱ δὲ λοιποὶ λόγοι τοῦ βασιλέως Δαυεὶδ οἱ πρότεροι καὶ οἱ ὕστεροι γεγραμμένοι εἰσὶν
traditions.VUL: Gesta autem David regis prióra , et novíssima scripta sunt
traditions.KJV: Now the acts of David the king , first and last , behold , they [ are ] written

29.english_reference: in the book of Samuel the seer , and in the book of Nathan the prophet , and in the book of Gad the seer

traditions.LXX: ἐν λόγοις Σαμουὴλ τοῦ βλέποντος καὶ ἐπὶ λόγων Ναθὰν τοῦ προφήτου καὶ ἐπὶ λόγων Γὰδ τοῦ βλέποντος ,

traditions.KJV: in the book of Samuel the seer , and in the book of Nathan the prophet , and in the book of Gad the seer ,

traditions.KJV: With all his reign and his might ,

traditions.KJV: and the times that went over him , and over Israel ,

30.english_reference: and over all the kingdoms of the countries
